title: Recorded record lookup
scenario: Fictional service LatticeNote. Assess only whether the supplied recorded evidence supports a security finding for the named target.

observations.content: Fixture policy: principal guest-17 belongs to tenant blue and may read only blue records. Record R-204 belongs to tenant amber and is marked private.
Completed request req-33 used guest-17 credentials and requested record R-204.
Response for req-33 was HTTP 200 and contained the exact private body marker AMBER-PRIVATE-91.

findings.why: A tenant-blue principal received a private tenant-amber record despite the fixture policy.
